Foundations

Plain CSS in native cascade layers: vendor, tokens, base, layout, components, pages, utilities. Blocks and parts are one-dash classes, variants are data-* attributes named after the Twig props, states are ARIA. Every example below is markup of the design engine's pages, rewritten to the new hooks, rendered by dist/acacia.css; photographs are replaced by a placeholder.

Four stepsHatua nne

  1. 1Find itTafutaSearch by activity or region, filter by length, price and month.Tafuta kwa shughuli au kanda, chuja kwa muda, bei na mwezi.
  2. 2Ask usTuulizeSend an enquiry. We confirm dates, what is included and the price.Tuma swali. Tunathibitisha tarehe, kilichojumuishwa na bei.
  3. 3Go with usNenda nasiWe run it ourselves or arrange it with people we know on the ground.Tunaiendesha wenyewe au tunaipanga na watu tunaowajua huko.
  4. 4Missing something?Kuna kinachokosekana?Tell us. We go and check it out, then list it.Tuambie. Tunakwenda kujionea, kisha tunaiorodhesha.

stack

assets/layout/stack.css · blocks .stack, .cluster

The placeholder of a missing photo; with data-state it lies over a photo on its way, the page's script moving it from hold to wait after 300 ms, to done on the photo's load event and to failed on its error event.

.placeholder[data-state="hold"] the first 300 ms: nothing shows

Photo to come

.placeholder[data-state="wait"] on its way: the ground and the glyph, breathing

Photo to come

.placeholder[data-state="done"] the photo has come and fades in

Photo to come

.placeholder[data-state="failed"] the photo never came: at rest, with its words

Photo to come

.placeholder[data-state="failed"][data-size="big"] a gallery's or a hero's box, or one over 200 px tall: the glyph at 44 px

Photo to come

.placeholder-thumb[data-state="wait"] a box under 90 px: the glyph at 20 px

.placeholder-thumb[data-state="failed"] a box under 90 px that failed

    loading

    assets/components/loading.css · blocks .loading

    A list a Live component renders again carries .loading and data-loading="delay(300)|addAttribute(data-waiting)": 300 ms into the request its rows become their own skeleton, each .loading-text a soft pill its own length, each .loading-icon hidden, the photos on the placeholder's ground. A map (.leaflet-container) breathes on that ground until its first tile.

    .seasons default

    The north: Kilimanjaro, Arusha and the northern parksKaskazini: Kilimanjaro, Arusha na hifadhi za kaskazini

    The main dry season runs from June to October, with a shorter dry spell in January and February. The long rains fall from about March to May and the short rains around November and December. Climbing and safaris are possible in most months, but the long rains make trails muddy and some roads hard.Kiangazi kikuu ni Juni hadi Oktoba, na kipindi kifupi cha ukavu Januari na Februari. Masika ni takriban Machi hadi Mei na vuli karibu Novemba na Desemba. Kupanda milima na safari kunawezekana miezi mingi, lakini masika hufanya njia kuwa na matope na barabara nyingine kuwa ngumu.

    The coast and ZanzibarPwani na Zanzibar

    Warm all year and humid. The heaviest rain usually falls from about April to May; June to October is drier and breezier. The sea is often calmest around the turn of the year.Joto mwaka mzima na unyevu. Mvua nyingi kwa kawaida hunyesha takriban Aprili hadi Mei; Juni hadi Oktoba ni kavu zaidi na kuna upepo. Bahari mara nyingi huwa tulivu zaidi karibu na mwanzo wa mwaka.

    The west: Lake Tanganyika, Gombe and MahaleMagharibi: Ziwa Tanganyika, Gombe na Mahale

    One long rainy season, roughly November to April, and a dry season from about May to October. Forest trails are easier in the dry months.Msimu mmoja mrefu wa mvua, takriban Novemba hadi Aprili, na kiangazi takriban Mei hadi Oktoba. Njia za msituni ni rahisi zaidi miezi ya kiangazi.

    The south: Ruaha, Nyerere and UdzungwaKusini: Ruaha, Nyerere na Udzungwa

    One rainy season, roughly November to April. The dry months, about June to October, are the classic safari season; some camps close during the heaviest rains.Msimu mmoja wa mvua, takriban Novemba hadi Aprili. Miezi ya kiangazi, takriban Juni hadi Oktoba, ndiyo msimu wa kawaida wa safari; baadhi ya kambi hufungwa wakati wa mvua nyingi.

    The highlands: Usambara and the Southern HighlandsNyanda za juu: Usambara na Nyanda za Juu Kusini

    Cooler than the lowlands, with misty mornings. Hiking is good in the drier months; bring layers and rain gear at any time of year.Baridi kuliko nyanda za chini, na asubuhi zenye ukungu. Matembezi ni mazuri miezi ya ukavu; beba nguo za tabaka na za mvua wakati wowote wa mwaka.

    .about default

    Only our own activitiesShughuli zetu wenyewe tu

    Everything listed here is run or arranged by Mr Activities, and you enquire with us. This is not a marketplace.Kila kitu kilichoorodheshwa hapa kinaendeshwa au kupangwa na Mr Activities, nawe unatuuliza sisi. Hapa si soko la makampuni mengi.

    We go and check it outTunakwenda kujionea

    If an activity isn't listed, tell us. We visit the place, try it, and then list it.Kama shughuli haijaorodheshwa, tuambie. Tunatembelea mahali, tunaijaribu, kisha tunaiorodhesha.

    Suggest an activityPendekeza shughuli

    About our pricesKuhusu bei zetu

    Prices are "from" prices in US dollars per person, park fees included where it says so. The price you see when you book is the price you pay.Bei ni "kuanzia" kwa dola za Marekani kwa mtu, ada za hifadhi zikiwemo panaposemwa. Bei unayoiona unapoweka nafasi ndiyo unayolipa.

    No reviews yetBado hakuna maoni

    We don't show ratings or reviews until real travellers can leave them here.Hatuonyeshi viwango wala maoni mpaka wasafiri halisi waweze kuyaacha hapa.

    Tanzania firstTanzania kwanza

    We start in Tanzania and may add neighbouring countries later.Tunaanza Tanzania na huenda tukaongeza nchi jirani baadaye.

    Who runs this siteNani anaendesha tovuti hii

    This site is operated by Mr Activities.Tovuti hii inaendeshwa na Mr Activities.
